title: Clouds Unbound
description: Clouds Unbound - immersive clouds that add depth and atmosphere to your skies.
body:
Clouds Unbound introduces block-based clouds that spawn naturally at high altitudes across the Overworld, blending seamlessly into the vanilla world generation for a fresh skyward adventure. The correct tool for clouds is a hoe, though, cloud blocks aren't solid! You fall right through! 

Natural Generation: Clouds appear in clusters high above terrain, respecting vanilla biome distribution.

The mod adds _4 unique cloud types_

The Overworld:
**Clouds** appear at y:256

The Nether:
**Sulfuric Clouds** appear at a altitude of y:80

**Coal Clouds** appear a few blocks higher y:100

The End:
**Chorus Clouds** start at a lower level than the overworld y:128
